# ziti_interfaces_v1_config (Data Source)

Ziti interfaces v1 config Data Source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ziti_interfaces_v1_config" "test_v1_interfaces_data" {
  name = "test.interfaces.v1"
}

output "ziti_interfaces_config" {
  value = data.ziti_interfaces_v1_config.test_v1_interfaces_data
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier
- `name` (String) Name of the config

### Read-Only

- `config_type_id` (String) The Id of a config-type
- `interfaces` (List of String) The names of the network interfaces that a tunneler should bind to for this service.
- `tags` (Map of String) Config Tags
